history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration perform a review to identify cases where staff members were unjustifiably granted monthly reimbursements for residential security measures until the year 9999, reclaim payments where necessary and take measures to avoid any such incidents in the future.
history.administration_response: RSCE has strengthened its monthly internal control review procedures relating to security reimbursement. All transactions are reviewed by a team leader prior to submission to the human resources partner for processing. This review ensures that monthly security reimbursements for separating staff members and for reassigned staff members are terminated in the month of separation or reassignment. RSCE conducted a review which identified cases in which staff members were unjustifiably granted monthly reimbursements for residential security measures. From this review exercise, perpetual end dates were corrected in Umoja and overpayments were recovered through payroll reductions.
